title: StochEP: Stochastic Equilibrium Propagation for Spiking Convergent Recurrent Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2511.11320v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) promise energy-efficient, sparse, biologically inspired computation. Training them with Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT) and surrogate gradients achieves strong performance but remains biologically implausible. Equilibrium Propagation (EP) provides a more local and biologically grounded alternative. However, existing EP frameworks for SNNs largely rely on deterministic neurons, which require complex mechanisms to handle spiking discontinuities and do not scale beyond simple benchmarks such as MNIST and Fashion-MNIST. Inspired by the stochastic nature of biological spiking mechanism and recent hardware trends, we propose a stochastic EP framework that integrates probabilistic spiking neurons into the EP paradigm. translated_title: StochEP：面向脉冲收敛循环神经网络的随机平衡传播
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络有望实现节能、稀疏且受生物启发的计算。使用时间反向传播（BPTT）和替代梯度来训练它们可以取得强大的性能，但在生物学上并不合理。平衡传播（EP）提供了一种更具局部性且更符合生物学原理的替代方案。然而，现有的针对SNN的EP框架主要依赖确定性神经元，这需要复杂的机制来处理脉冲的不连续性，并且无法扩展到MNIST和Fashion-MNIST等简单基准之外。受生物脉冲机制的随机特性以及近期硬件发展趋势的启发，我们提出了一种随机EP框架，将概率性脉冲神经元整合到EP范式中。这种表述平滑了优化景观，稳定了训练过程，并使SNN中的学习变得高效且可扩展。我们提供了理论保证，表明该方法...
tldr: 本文提出StochEP框架，通过将概率性脉冲神经元融入平衡传播范式，平滑了优化景观并稳定了训练，实现了脉冲神经网络高效且可扩展的学习，同时提供了理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes StochEP, a stochastic Equilibrium Propagation framework that integrates probabilistic spiking neurons into the EP paradigm, smoothing the optimization landscape, stabilizing training, and enabling efficient and scalable learning for spiking neural networks beyond simple benchmarks with theoretical guarantees.
